title: Treadmill HAMMER FlyRun 4.0 NorsK
descriptionHtml:
Experience a whole new running workout with the Hammer FlyRun 4.0 treadmill. With a maximum power of 5.5 HP, this model offers maximum speeds of up to 24 km/h. The extra wide 152 x 50 cm running track allows you to train in comfort and safety. Thanks to digital connectivity, you can train with apps like Kinomap and Zwift. Thanks to the Pro Solid construction, the screen and handles are separate and remain stable even during intense workouts.

NB: The product is already 95% assembled in the box.

The manufacturer is Hammer.

Details:
  • Screen: LED/LCD
  • LED/LCD
  • Engine: 2,75 HP (max 5,5 HP)
  • Speed: 1-24 km/h.
  • Inclines: 12 (electronically adjustable)
  • Running track size: 152 x 50 cm.
  • Dimensions: 181 x 83 x 130 cm
  • Folded dimensions: 124 x 83 x 154 cm
  • Product weight: 82 kg
  • Maximum operating weight: 150 kg

title: Walking Pad TOORX TRX Walker EVO
descriptionHtml:
The Toorx TRX Walker EVO is specifically designed for rehabilitation and moderate-paced walking. Its low frame and speed range from 0.4 km/h make it ideal for the elderly or recovering. Secure hand grips and a safe design ensure stability and ease of use at every step.

Manufactured by Toorx.

More info:
  • Screen: LCD, 113 x 63 mm
  • Exercise programmes: 12
  • Motor: 2 HP
  • Speed: 0.4-8 km/h.
  • Running track size: 127 x 43 cm.
  • Dimensions: 163,5 x 70 x 131,5 cm
  • Dimensions when folded: 113 x 71,5 x 140 cm (without handles)
  • Product weight: 58 kg
  • Maximum operating weight: 110 kg
